description: This file defines the baggage package for OpenTelemetry, including data structures and functions for handling baggage properties, members, and baggage lists, with validation, parsing, and encoding according to W3C Baggage specifications.

methods.name: NewKeyProperty
methods.description: Creates a new Property with a key, validating the key according to baggage rules.

methods.name: NewKeyValueProperty
methods.description: Creates a new Property with a key and value, validating both and decoding the value.

methods.name: NewKeyValuePropertyRaw
methods.description: Creates a new Property with a raw key and value, validating both.

methods.name: parseProperty
methods.description: Parses a Property from a string, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the Property according to baggage rules.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the key of the Property.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the value of the Property and a boolean indicating if it is set.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Encodes the Property into a string for headers.

methods.name: fromInternalProperties
methods.description: Converts internal baggage properties to external Property slice.

methods.name: asInternal
methods.description: Converts external Properties to internal baggage properties.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Properties slice.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates each Property in the slice.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Encodes Properties into a header string.

methods.name: NewMember
methods.description: Creates a new Member with validation and decoding.

methods.name: NewMemberRaw
methods.description: Creates a new Member with raw key and value, validating both.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses a Member from a string, decoding and validating.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the Member's key, value, and properties.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the key of the Member.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the value of the Member.

methods.name: Properties
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Member's properties.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Encodes the Member into a header string.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Baggage from validated Members.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a baggage string into a Baggage object.

methods.name: Member
methods.description: Returns a specific Member by key.

methods.name: Members
methods.description: Returns all Members in the Baggage.

methods.name: SetMember
methods.description: Returns a new Baggage with a Member added or replaced.

methods.name: DeleteMember
methods.description: Returns a new Baggage with a Member removed.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of Members.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Encodes the Baggage into a header string.

methods.name: parsePropertyInternal
methods.description: Parses a Property from a string following W3C spec.

methods.name: skipSpace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in a string.

methods.name: validateBaggageName
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid baggage name.

methods.name: validateBaggageValue
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid baggage value.

methods.name: validateKey
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid baggage key.

methods.name: validateKeyChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid in a baggage key.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid baggage value.

methods.name: validateValueChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid in a baggage value.

methods.name: valueEscape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for baggage value encoding.

methods.name: shouldEscape
methods.description: Determines if a byte should be percent-encoded in baggage value.
